Who We Are

About Us

A community-led journey that grew from sharing local updates into meaningful social service.

Our Journey

Our journey began in 2018 with Khammamcity.04, a social media platform sharing local updates, photos, and videos. After reaching our first 10,000 followers, we celebrated by distributing examination kits to school students, marking the beginning of our social service journey.

During the COVID-19 pandemic, we supported communities through volunteer work and food donations. In 2021, we officially registered our NGO with the Government of Telangana.

Since then, we have been working towards community welfare through educational support, regular food donations, assistance to single women and elderly couples, blood donation camps, and free skill-development training in Tally, Python, and Digital Marketing.

What We Work For

We believe that consistent community service, education, and support can help people live with dignity and opportunity.

Our volunteers participate in initiatives that respond to local needs, from student support and food distribution to blood donation and skill development.

Connect With Us

Our Aim

To support underprivileged students and vulnerable communities through education, food assistance, skill development, and essential support.

Our Vision

To build an educated, hunger-free, and empowered society where everyone has equal opportunities and can live with dignity.

Our Mission

To create a positive and lasting social impact through continuous community service, educational initiatives, food distribution, healthcare support, and volunteer participation.
